section_summary: This section records Japanese merchant vessel arrivals, departures, routes and cargoes reported from Asia, the Americas and the Pacific in April and early May 1941. Many telegrams are followed by State Department paraphrases sent to the Navy. Reports also note German passengers, strategic mineral shipments, and a decline in Japanese vessel movement reports.

subfiles.title: Nozima Maru departure from Tampico
subfiles.about: Reports the Nozima Maru sailing for Los Angeles and Japan with lead, zinc and antimony.
subfiles.summary: The freighter arrived from New York in ballast and cleared Tampico via the Panama Canal with 3,100 tons of minerals.

subfiles.title: Nozima Maru report for OPNAV
subfiles.about: Copies the Nozima Maru movement and cargo report.
subfiles.summary: Copies the report of its Tampico departure with lead, zinc and antimony.

subfiles.title: Yoneyama and Kenyo sailings
subfiles.about: Reports two April 14 departures from Yokohama.
subfiles.summary: Yoneyama sailed for Jose Panganiban; tanker Kenyo sailed for San Francisco.

subfiles.title: Yoneyama and Kenyo report for OPNAV
subfiles.about: Relays the Yoneyama and Kenyo departures.
subfiles.summary: Paraphrases the April 14 Yokohama sailings for Navy use.

subfiles.title: Arizona Maru at Santos
subfiles.about: Reports Arizona Maru arriving from Kobe and leaving Santos for Yokohama.
subfiles.summary: The vessel arrived April 11 and departed April 16 via South Africa.

subfiles.title: Arizona Maru report for OPNAV
subfiles.about: Relays the Arizona Maru itinerary.
subfiles.summary: Paraphrases its Santos arrival and departure for Yokohama.

subfiles.title: Bills of health issued at Kobe
subfiles.about: Reports bills of health for Seia Maru and Hikawa Maru.
subfiles.summary: Notes a recent decrease in bills of health issued to Japanese merchant vessels.

subfiles.title: Kobe bills of health report for OPNAV
subfiles.about: Relays Kobe's report of fewer bills of health.
subfiles.summary: Names Hikawa Maru and Seia Maru as recent recipients.

subfiles.title: Reported escape aboard Nako Maru
subfiles.about: Reports a newspaper claim that six escaped Germans boarded Nako Maru.
subfiles.summary: Collins considers stowing away plausible but doubts a claimed pickup at sea.

subfiles.title: Nako Maru escape report for OPNAV
subfiles.about: Relays the Nako Maru escape allegation and the six Germans' names.
subfiles.summary: The paraphrase distinguishes the plausible stowaway claim from the doubtful pickup at sea.

subfiles.title: Borneo Maru and Amagisan Maru movements
subfiles.about: Reports arrivals and departures of two Japanese vessels at Singapore.
subfiles.summary: Borneo Maru sailed for Calcutta; Amagisan Maru sailed for New York via Manila, Kobe and Panama.

subfiles.title: Singapore vessel movements for OPNAV
subfiles.about: Relays routes of Borneo Maru and Amagisan Maru.
subfiles.summary: Paraphrases Patton's Singapore movement report.

subfiles.title: Melbourne Maru departure
subfiles.about: Reports Melbourne Maru sailing for Japan.
subfiles.summary: The vessel left Bombay via Singapore and Shanghai.

subfiles.title: Melbourne Maru report for OPNAV
subfiles.about: Relays Melbourne Maru's departure from Bombay.
subfiles.summary: Lists Singapore and Shanghai on its route to Japan.

subfiles.title: Tuyama Maru at Antofagasta
subfiles.about: Reports Tuyama Maru's arrival and departure.
subfiles.summary: It arrived from Valparaíso April 12 and sailed for Tocopilla April 18.

subfiles.title: Tuyama Maru report for OPNAV
subfiles.about: Relays Tuyama Maru's Antofagasta movements.
subfiles.summary: Paraphrases the Valparaíso arrival and Tocopilla departure.

subfiles.title: Nissin Maru No. 2 and other sailings
subfiles.about: Reports April 15 departures for Los Angeles, Calcutta and Batavia.
subfiles.summary: Names tanker Nissin Maru No. 2, Toba and Burma Maru.

subfiles.title: April 15 Yokohama sailings for OPNAV
subfiles.about: Relays three April 15 vessel sailings.
subfiles.summary: The paraphrase renders Burma Maru as Bunma Maru and Nissin as Nissen.

subfiles.title: Akatsuki Maru and Yamagiku Maru movements
subfiles.about: Reports two vessels leaving Japanese ports for overseas destinations.
subfiles.summary: Akatsuki Maru left Tokuyama for Los Angeles; Yamagiku Maru was leaving Miike for Saigon and possibly San Francisco.

subfiles.title: Navy transmission routing slip
subfiles.about: Directs transmission by Simplex Printer under confidential classification.
subfiles.summary: Routing instruction for a confidential Navy transmission.

subfiles.title: Akatsuki Maru and Yamagiku Maru telegram copy
subfiles.about: Copies the tanker and steamship movement report.
subfiles.summary: The copy clarifies the second ship's name as Yamagiku Maru.

subfiles.title: Suwa, Seia and Sydney Maru sailings
subfiles.about: Reports April 16 Japanese vessel departures.
subfiles.summary: Suwa and Sydney Maru headed for Melbourne; Seia sailed toward South America's east coast.

subfiles.title: April 16 sailings for OPNAV
subfiles.about: Relays Suwa, Seia and Sydney Maru itineraries.
subfiles.summary: Paraphrases routes through the Philippines, Los Angeles and Panama.

subfiles.title: Hikawa Maru and Genoa Maru sailings
subfiles.about: Reports April 17 departures for North America and Bombay.
subfiles.summary: Hikawa Maru sailed for Seattle and Vancouver; Genoa Maru reportedly sailed for Bombay.

subfiles.title: Hikawa and Genoa report for OPNAV
subfiles.about: Relays the two April 17 sailings.
subfiles.summary: Paraphrases Genoa Maru's reported Bombay departure and Hikawa Maru's North American departure.

subfiles.title: Heiyo Maru and Sitaki Maru at Buenaventura
subfiles.about: Reports Heiyo Maru taking aboard Germans and Sitaki Maru due for Callao.
subfiles.summary: Heiyo Maru departed Buenaventura for Panama, Mexican ports, Los Angeles and Japan with 25 Germans.

subfiles.title: Buenaventura movements for OPNAV
subfiles.about: Relays the Heiyo Maru and Sitaki Maru report.
subfiles.summary: Notes Heiyo Maru's 25 German passengers and Sitaki Maru's planned Callao departure.

subfiles.title: Duplicate Hikawa and Genoa sailing report
subfiles.about: Repeats the April 17 Hikawa and Genoa sailings.
subfiles.summary: The Hikawa name is partly garbled; Seattle, Vancouver and Bombay destinations are legible.

subfiles.title: Duplicate sailing report for OPNAV
subfiles.about: Relays the duplicate Genoa and unnamed ship report.
subfiles.summary: The paraphrase omits the vessel name for the Seattle and Vancouver departure.

subfiles.title: Toa Maru leaves Buenos Aires
subfiles.about: Reports Toa Maru's Buenos Aires arrival and departure.
subfiles.summary: The ship departed for Los Angeles via Brazilian ports and Panama.

subfiles.title: Toa Maru report for OPNAV and Coast Guard
subfiles.about: Relays Toa Maru's route from Buenos Aires.
subfiles.summary: Paraphrases Armour's April 21 telegram.

subfiles.title: Onoe Maru departure from Bombay
subfiles.about: Reports Onoe Maru sailing for Kobe.
subfiles.summary: The April 23 route ran via Singapore and Shanghai.

subfiles.title: Onoe Maru report for OPNAV
subfiles.about: Relays Onoe Maru's Bombay departure.
subfiles.summary: Paraphrases the Singapore and Shanghai route to Kobe.

subfiles.title: Four vessels at Singapore
subfiles.about: Reports movements of Himalaya, Hakone, Marumoto and Sumatra.
subfiles.summary: Lists arrivals and onward routes to Keelung, Bombay, Calcutta and Karachi.

subfiles.title: Singapore movement report for OPNAV
subfiles.about: Relays four vessel arrivals and departures at Singapore.
subfiles.summary: The paraphrase identifies the uncertain third vessel as Marumoto Maru.

subfiles.title: Kazuura, Syokyu, Tosei and Havre Maru sailings
subfiles.about: Reports April 19–20 sailings toward Asia and Seattle.
subfiles.summary: Kazuura sailed for Saigon and Manila; Syokyu for Manila; Tosei for Seattle; Havre Maru reportedly for Calcutta.

subfiles.title: April 19–20 sailings for OPNAV
subfiles.about: Relays four Yokohama departures.
subfiles.summary: The paraphrase renders Syokyu as Syokyo.

subfiles.title: Kobe bills of health and Philippine-bound ships
subfiles.about: Lists bills of health and ships bound for Philippine ports.
subfiles.summary: Names Yamashimo, Ginyo and Kurama Maru, plus four Philippine-bound vessels; Ginyo's destination is uncertain.

subfiles.title: Kobe bills of health report for OPNAV
subfiles.about: Relays Kobe vessel clearances with an unresolved Ginyo destination.
subfiles.summary: A repetition was requested to establish Ginyo Maru's destination.

subfiles.title: Corrected Kobe bills of health telegram
subfiles.about: Corrects Ginyo Maru's destination to Balboa.
subfiles.summary: Also repeats Yamashimo and Kurama routes and the four Philippine-bound vessels.

subfiles.title: Corrected Kobe report for OPNAV
subfiles.about: Relays the corrected Ginyo Maru destination.
subfiles.summary: Ginyo Maru was bound for Balboa via Honolulu and the Canal Zone.

subfiles.title: Kimikawa Maru at Peruvian ports
subfiles.about: Reports Kimikawa Maru moving from Cerro Azul to Chancay.
subfiles.summary: It arrived April 20 and departed April 22.

subfiles.title: Ginyo and Bandoeng departures
subfiles.about: Reports Ginyo's South American route and Bandoeng's Batavia sailing.
subfiles.summary: Ginyo's itinerary includes Hawaii, California, Mexico, Nicaragua and Balboa.

subfiles.title: Ginyo and Bandoeng report for OPNAV
subfiles.about: Relays the April 21 Ginyo and Bandoeng sailings.
subfiles.summary: Lists Ginyo's ports of call toward South America's west coast.

subfiles.title: Cross-reference to Singapore vessel report
subfiles.about: Points to Patton's April 9 telegram on Japanese vessels of specified tonnages.
subfiles.summary: Refers readers to Singapore telegram 86 in file 800.8591/741.

subfiles.title: Yamabiko Maru at Santos
subfiles.about: Reports Yamabiko Maru's Santos visit and departure for Kobe.
subfiles.summary: It arrived from Montevideo April 14 and sailed April 22 via Panama and Los Angeles.

subfiles.title: Yamabiko Maru report for OPNAV
subfiles.about: Relays Yamabiko Maru's Santos arrival and departure.
subfiles.summary: Paraphrases its Montevideo origin and Kobe destination.

subfiles.title: Akagi Maru mineral cargo at Manzanillo
subfiles.about: Reports Akagi Maru loading mercury and molybdenum for Japan.
subfiles.summary: The ship arrived from Paita, loaded 1,124 flasks of mercury and 168 sacks of molybdenum, then sailed via Los Angeles with other strategic cargo in transit.

subfiles.title: Akagi Maru cargo paraphrase
subfiles.about: Relays Akagi Maru's Manzanillo call and strategic cargo.
subfiles.summary: Repeats the mercury and molybdenum quantities and additional metals carried in transit.

subfiles.title: Memorandum on strategic materials shipments
subfiles.about: Urges faster government action on strategic mineral acquisition in light of shipments to Japan.
subfiles.summary: The writer cites reports from Tampico and elsewhere, questions whether 3,800 tons of lead fall under prior commitments, and asks the recipient to press for action.

subfiles.title: Aobasan Maru lead shipment
subfiles.about: Reports Aobasan Maru carrying 3,800 tons of lead toward Japan.
subfiles.summary: The freighter arrived from New York and was due to depart for Baytown via the Panama Canal.

subfiles.title: Fourteenth Naval District movement report
subfiles.about: Reports cancelled Hawaii calls and fewer Japanese vessel movement reports.
subfiles.summary: Arima, Takaoka and Naruto were not expected to call at Hawaii en route to the Americas. Movement reports had decreased markedly since about April 15.

subfiles.title: Japanese commercial vessels at Auckland
subfiles.from: J. G. Groeninger, American Consul, Auckland
subfiles.about: Reports the next advertised Japanese commercial vessel sailing from Auckland.
subfiles.summary: Sydney Maru was due May 20 on a service connecting Auckland with Hong Kong, Shanghai and Yokohama.

subfiles.title: Havana Maru and Boston Maru at Singapore
subfiles.about: Reports movements of Havana Maru and Boston Maru.
subfiles.summary: Havana Maru sailed for Japan; Boston Maru sailed for Batu Pahat.

subfiles.title: Singapore vessel report for OPNAV
subfiles.about: Relays Havana and Boston Maru arrivals and departures.
subfiles.summary: Lists Bombay and Moji as their respective origins.

subfiles.title: Tuyama Maru at Cerro Azul and Chancay
subfiles.about: Reports Tuyama Maru's same-day arrival and departure.
subfiles.summary: It arrived from Cerro Azul April 25 and sailed for Chancay.

subfiles.title: Olympia Maru and other Asian sailings
subfiles.about: Reports Olympia Maru's Cebu departure and three additional sailings.
subfiles.summary: Olympia Maru sailed via Christmas Island; other reported destinations were Saigon and Batavia.

subfiles.title: April 22–23 sailings for OPNAV
subfiles.about: Relays Olympia, Bangkok, Haruna and Asahisau sailings.
subfiles.summary: The paraphrase lists routes to Cebu, Saigon and Batavia.

subfiles.title: Brisbane Maru, Sinkoku and unnamed tanker
subfiles.about: Reports three April 24 tanker and freighter departures.
subfiles.summary: Brisbane Maru and tanker Sinkoku headed for Los Angeles; an unnamed tanker headed for San Diego and Panama.

subfiles.title: April 24 vessel departures for OPNAV
subfiles.about: Relays routes of Brisbane Maru, Sinkoku and an unnamed tanker.
subfiles.summary: Notes the apparent omission of the San Diego-bound tanker's name.

subfiles.title: Heiyo Maru at Acapulco
subfiles.about: Reports Heiyo Maru's passengers, route and mercury cargo.
subfiles.summary: The ship arrived from Balboa and departed for Los Angeles via Manzanillo; 47 mostly German and Japanese passengers boarded.

subfiles.title: Heiyo Maru Acapulco report for OPNAV
subfiles.about: Relays the Heiyo Maru Acapulco call.
subfiles.summary: Notes 47 passengers and a reported substantial mercury shipment for Japan.

subfiles.title: Kimikawa Maru ordered to Japan
subfiles.about: Reports new orders for Kimikawa Maru.
subfiles.summary: The vessel was ordered to sail directly from Paita to Japan.

subfiles.title: Kimikawa Maru orders for OPNAV
subfiles.about: Relays Kimikawa Maru's direct-to-Japan orders.
subfiles.summary: The ship was then at Paita.

subfiles.title: Sanuki Maru at Peruvian ports
subfiles.about: Reports Sanuki Maru arriving from Cerro Azul and leaving for Chancay.
subfiles.summary: It arrived April 27 and departed April 29.

subfiles.title: Sanuki Maru telegram copy
subfiles.about: Copies the Sanuki Maru movement report.
subfiles.summary: Repeats its Cerro Azul arrival and Chancay departure.

subfiles.title: Sanuki Maru Navy transmission sheet
subfiles.about: Routes a partly obscured Sanuki Maru report to the Navy.
subfiles.summary: The page carries a Simplex Printer instruction and fragments of the Lima telegram.

subfiles.title: Heiyo Maru cargo and passengers at Manzanillo
subfiles.about: Reports Heiyo Maru loading cargo and German passengers.
subfiles.summary: Four Germans boarded; the ship loaded 735 flasks of mercury, turpentine and resin before sailing via Los Angeles for Japan.

subfiles.title: Heiyo Maru Manzanillo report for OPNAV
subfiles.about: Relays Heiyo Maru's Manzanillo arrival and planned departure.
subfiles.summary: The brief paraphrase mentions cargo and passengers without quantities.

subfiles.title: Late April Yokohama sailings
subfiles.about: Reports seven vessels sailing toward Hawaii, the Americas and Asia.
subfiles.summary: Names Asama, Nitta, Daini Ogura, Turuga, Chile, Sidney and Okitu, with destinations including California, Manila, Calcutta, Basra, Melbourne and Bombay.

subfiles.title: Late April sailings for OPNAV
subfiles.about: Relays Linnell's seven vessel departures.
subfiles.summary: Paraphrases the April 25–27 routes, including tanker Daini Ogura's San Luis destination.

subfiles.title: Tusima Maru lead and zinc shipment
subfiles.about: Reports Tusima Maru clearing Tampico with lead and zinc for Japan.
subfiles.summary: The freighter arrived from New York and was sailing via the Panama Canal to Los Angeles with 1,800 tons.

subfiles.title: Tusima Maru report for OPNAV
subfiles.about: Relays Tusima Maru's departure and mineral cargo.
subfiles.summary: The 1,800 tons of lead and zinc were destined for Japan.

subfiles.title: Toa Maru at Santos
subfiles.about: Reports Toa Maru's Santos arrival and onward route to Kobe.
subfiles.summary: It came from Buenos Aires and departed via Rio de Janeiro, Fortaleza, Panama and Los Angeles.

subfiles.title: Toa Maru Santos report for OPNAV
subfiles.about: Relays Toa Maru's Santos movements and route.
subfiles.summary: Paraphrases the April 24 arrival and April 29 departure.

subfiles.title: Siamese Maru leaves Puntarenas
subfiles.about: Reports Siamese Maru sailing from Puntarenas.
subfiles.summary: It left April 29 for Corinto, Manzanillo and California ports.

subfiles.title: Siamese Maru report for OPNAV
subfiles.about: Relays Siamese Maru's Puntarenas departure.
subfiles.summary: Lists Corinto, Manzanillo and California as its route.

subfiles.title: Lima Maru and Onoe Maru at Singapore
subfiles.about: Reports two vessels arriving and departing Singapore for Japan.
subfiles.summary: Lima Maru came from Rangoon and sailed via Hong Kong; Onoe Maru came from Bombay and was to sail via Shanghai.

subfiles.title: Singapore May 1 report for OPNAV
subfiles.about: Relays Lima Maru and Onoe Maru movements.
subfiles.summary: Paraphrases their arrivals and onward routes to Japan.

subfiles.title: Arima Maru leaves Puntarenas
subfiles.about: Reports Arima Maru sailing for Balboa and South American ports.
subfiles.summary: The vessel departed Puntarenas on May 1.
